maddeler.e:
يتمايز (form VI)
# يَتَمَايَزُ (yatamāyazu) /ja.ta.maː.ja.zu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَمَايَزَ (tamāyaza)
# يَتَمَايَزَ (yatamāyaza) /ja.ta.maː.ja.za/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَمَايَزَ (tamāyaza)
# يَتَمَايَزْ (yatamāyaz) /ja.ta.maː.jaz/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of تَمَايَزَ (tamāyaza)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
